editorial:
You get a front-row seat to the wild world of movie monsters, starting with a Pittsburgh kid who walked away from medical school to chase a dream. Greg Nicotero's story is packed with greasepaint, latex, and big Hollywood names, and it feels like hanging out with friends who love horror. The documentary follows his rise, his team at KNB EFX, and the messy, creative work behind creatures that scared you for years. It also shows how passion can turn into a real career.

The interviews and workshop footage keep things lively, though some sections move slowly if you are not into effects details. You will see how KNB EFX became a powerhouse and why directors trust Nicotero. It is best for horror fans and curious movie lovers. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Greg looks back at the monsters, movies, and friendships that shaped his life. You see that his risky choice paid off, with KNB EFX still busy and directors still calling him. The documentary ends on a hopeful note, showing that his love for horror never faded and his next big project is already waiting.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves horror movies, movie makeup, or behind-the-scenes stories.
